archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & CORPORATE AUTHORITY (Recruitment & IT Placement)
design_intent: A high-trust, elite IT career placement and enterprise recruitment platform. Explicitly structured as a corporate recruitment agency (NOT a coaching or training institute). Palette combines Deep Obsidian, Crisp Slate-Navy, Pure White, and kinetic Signal Teal/Electric Azure accents. Clean Swiss grid alignment, dense data clarity, generous negative space, and clear candidate track pathways.

entry_surfaces./: High-authority corporate recruitment split hero: Left features company mission statement, quick category quick-filters (Freshers, Non-IT Transition, Career Gap, Experienced), live active openings metric, and dual CTA (Explore Openings / Candidate Registration); Right features interactive live job ticker card and application stage pipeline preview.
entry_surfaces./login: Corporate split login: Left dark-navy branding & recruitment security manifesto panel, Right white card with role selector tab (Candidate / Employer / Staff / Admin) and session form.
entry_surfaces./register: Recruitment candidate onboarding split view: Left guidance panel detailing hiring tracks and direct placement workflow, Right multi-step candidate profile and resume submission form.
entry_surfaces./jobs: Full-width dual-filter marketplace: Top search bar with keywords/location/track + left facet rail (Experience, Tech Stack, Mode, CTC range in ₹ Lakhs) and right dynamic job card list.
entry_surfaces./candidate/dashboard: Command center grid: Top application stage tracker (Applied → Offer Received), left status stream with upcoming interviews, right recommended openings & question sets.
entry_surfaces./admin: Restricted administrative console: Density-first KPI tiles (Job moderation, Candidate pipeline, Fee reconciliation, CSV import), data tables with batch action bars.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. STRUCTURE & IDENTITY: DigiPhonics Technology is an IT recruitment, corporate staffing, and direct career placement company. NEVER describe it as a 'training institute' or 'coaching center'. Use corporate recruitment terminology (Hiring Partners, Direct Placements, Candidate Shortlisting, CTC Range in ₹ LPA, Talent Acquisition).

2. HOMEPAGE HERO: Build the hero with the primary headline 'Your Experience. Your Potential. Your Next IT Career.' and 4 prominent category CTA buttons / filter cards (Freshers, Non-IT to IT, Career Gap, Experienced) leading to both dedicated category landing pages and pre-filtered job views.

3. CATEGORY LANDING PAGES: Create 4 distinct landing pages (/candidates/freshers, /candidates/non-it, /candidates/career-gap, /candidates/experienced) with bespoke messaging, roadmaps to placement, eligibility criteria, CTC projections, and dedicated fast-track registration forms.

4. JOB PORTAL (/jobs and /jobs/:id): Full-featured search with keyword search, location (Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Noida, Remote), candidate track category filter, experience level, salary range (₹3-40 LPA), job save functionality, and rich application modal with resume upload.

5. EMPLOYER JOB-POSTING PORTAL (/employer/post-job and /employer/dashboard): Form for employers/recruiters to submit job requirements (Title, Skills, Vacancies, Salary range, Job description), subject to Admin moderation/approval.

6. CANDIDATE PORTAL (/candidate/dashboard): Comprehensive authenticated dashboard with (a) Profile completeness gauge, (b) 8-stage visual application progress timeline, (c) Interview schedules with meeting links, (d) Saved and applied jobs, (e) Resume manager, (f) Question library bookmarks, (g) Service-charge acceptance status and invoice downloads.

7. INTERVIEW QUESTIONS LIBRARY (/interview-questions): Rich resource with 30+ categorized domains (React, Java, Python, SQL, DevOps, DSA, System Design, QA, etc.), difficulty filters (Easy/Medium/Hard), search, bookmarking, and an interactive 'Random Practice Set' with MCQ and flashcard modes.

8. SERVICE CHARGE & INVOICE MODULE: Realistic corporate post-placement fee terms (e.g. nominal placement processing charge upon offer letter release), candidate digital consent signoff, generated invoice download view with manual reconciliation status (payments disabled as specified in prompt).

9. EMPLOYEE / RECRUITER PORTAL (/employee/dashboard): Staff dashboard with virtual digital ID card, assigned candidates, candidate status progression actions, interview link scheduler, and internal notes.

10. ADMIN PORTAL (/admin): Executive command center with metrics (Total candidates, active jobs, placement conversion rate, pending approvals), Job moderation queue (Approve/Reject), Candidate application pipeline manager, Question bank manager with CSV import/export simulator, Fee config & invoice verification, Enquiry inbox, and Audit logs.

11. CONTENT & LEGAL PAGES: Full polished pages for About DigiPhonics, Corporate Services, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Placement Service Agreement, Refund Policy, and Contact Us with a working enquiry form.

12. DATA SEEDING: Seed comprehensive, realistic Indian IT recruitment data (e.g., jobs across Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad with realistic LPA salaries, 50+ interview questions, pre-populated candidate applications with varied stages from 'Applied' to 'Offer Received', sample invoices, and seed credentials for candidate, recruiter, employer, and admin in memory/test_credentials.md).

13. TESTABILITY: Ensure every interactive button, link, form input, and status badge includes data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='job-search-input', data-testid='apply-now-btn', data-testid='candidate-login-btn').
